Shipping

All Orders are fulfilled and then shipped to anywhere in Canada in 1-3 working days on average.

All orders come with tracking information once shipped.

Returns

Not happy with your purchase? No worries, we've got you covered!

You may return it within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange, no questions asked. To initiate a return, just contact our customer service team at support@thefleececompany.com.

settings.text: Made from lightweight cotton, this pastel pajama set feels soft, breathable, and smooth on the skin. The gentle check pattern in calming colors adds a fresh, timeless charm, perfect for cozy nights and relaxed mornings.
This pastel set blends airy fabric with all-day ease. With its soft texture, relaxed fit, and elastic waistband, it’s made for slow mornings, cozy evenings, and effortless lounging.
We won’t rest until you're completely happy with your Pyjama.
I took this pyjama set on a summer trip and haven’t stopped wearing it since. The cotton is incredibly soft and airy it’s like sleeping on a cloud. I’m already planning to get another color!
